newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria celebrates Moslem Eid al-Fitr on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Algeria celebrates Moslem Eid al-Fitr on Saturday.

text.p: Algeria on Saturday marked the Moslem Eid al-Fitr feast, the Algerian Ministry of Religious Affairs said in a statement quoted by state-run radio.
The Eid al-Fitr, which marks the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, lasts two days, Algerian officials said.
Algerians witnessed the bloodiest round of violence in their country's five years of conflict during Ramadan in which between 250 and 300 people have been killed in bombings and massacres.
The authorities blamed the violence on Moslem guerrillas.
About 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Moslem fundamentalists had taken a commanding lead.
